definition.hypothesis: Compare declared covariance settings and retain every incomplete or invalid-data outcome.
definition.name: synthetic-risk-review

error.message: mark timestamp lies after valuation time

concentration.denominator: total marked equity including cash and dividend assets

history.policy: Adjacent complete observations only; no forward filling, no joining over gaps; split-adjusted price-only levels and base-per-quote FX; returns rounded half-even to 12 decimal places

result.rounding_policy: Journal currency rounding for baseline/stresses; stressed per-unit quotes rounded half-even to 18 places; historical simple returns rounded half-even to 12 places; covariance/tails exact on that grid; displayed diagnostics 18 places
result.scope: Descriptive long-only equity/spot risk from a replayed journal, operator-declared synchronous price history and explicit shocks; no trading advice, regulatory capital or prediction

covariance.annualization_assumption: Square-root-of-time scaling under the declared equal-period/no-serial-correlation approximation; not a forecast
covariance.method: sample covariance (n-1), then off-diagonal multiplied by (1-shrinkage); unchanged diagonal

historical_tail.method: Loss = negative static-exposure historical P&L. VaR is ceil(confidence*n) in ascending losses; ES integrates the worst (1-confidence)*n observation mass with a fractional boundary. Equal observation weights; signed gains are not floored at zero.

valuation.fx_direction: base currency units per one quote currency unit
valuation.rounding_policy: half-even at each cash/position conversion to base currency
valuation.scope: current long-only settled-cash journal valuation; no FX profit attribution or tax reporting

warnings.detail: Historical shocks revalue current marked exposures; these are not realized historical portfolio returns
